title: Lambert material
author: DeepBuild
description: The library's MeshLambertMaterial: a surface that reflects by its diffuse lobe alone, as material@1 with specular_level 0; Color sRGB to our linear base color, emissive × emissiveIntensity to our emission. A geometry instance wears it by naming `<instance>.material` in its `material`.

color.about: Color as 0xRRGGBB, sRGB; linear in ours

emissive.about: Color as 0xRRGGBB, sRGB; linear in ours

fog.about: true only: the sky's fog reaches every surface

refuses.map: Write the picture on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `maps.base_color`.
refuses.lightMap: Leave it out: material@1 takes no baked light of its own.
refuses.lightMapIntensity: Leave it out: material@1 takes no baked light of its own.
refuses.aoMap: Write the picture on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `maps.occlusion`.
refuses.aoMapIntensity: Leave it out: `maps.occlusion` shades the ambient light at its full strength.
refuses.emissiveMap: Write the picture on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `maps.emission`.
refuses.bumpMap: Write a normal map on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `normal_map`.
refuses.bumpScale: Write a normal map on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `normal_map`.
refuses.normalMap: Write the picture on material@1 itself, by its hash, as `normal_map`.
refuses.normalMapType: Leave it out: `normal_map` is in tangent space.
refuses.normalScale: Leave it out: `normal_map` is read at its full strength.
refuses.displacementMap: Leave it out: a material moves no vertex; shape the part with its builder or a modifier.
refuses.displacementScale: Leave it out: a material moves no vertex; shape the part with its builder or a modifier.
refuses.displacementBias: Leave it out: a material moves no vertex; shape the part with its builder or a modifier.
refuses.specularMap: Leave it out: this material has no specular lobe.
refuses.alphaMap: Write the picture on material@1 itself: the alpha of `maps.base_color`, under `alpha_mode`.
refuses.envMap: Leave it out: every part takes the document's one environment, sky@1's `environment`.
refuses.envMapRotation: Leave it out: every part takes the document's one environment, sky@1's `environment`.
refuses.envMapIntensity: Leave it out: every part takes the document's one environment, sky@1's `environment`.
refuses.combine: Leave it out: this material has no specular lobe to mix an environment into.
refuses.reflectivity: Leave it out: this material has no specular lobe to mix an environment into.
refuses.refractionRatio: Leave it out: this material has no specular lobe to mix an environment into.
refuses.wireframe: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinewidth: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinecap: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.wireframeLinejoin: Leave it out: how a surface is rasterized is the renderer's; for its edges alone, draw mark.line@1 items.
refuses.flatShading: Leave it out: a part's normals come from its builder.
